text:
sophie: morning — want to lock the benchmark narrative for launch: hero chart, three microcards, gated benchmark kit, and a short webinar. target launch next Thursday.

miguel: +1. lean the hook toward product PMs: 'how teams cut token spend while keeping fast UX'. secondary angle for infra: tunable latency knobs.

hana: hero suggestion: scatter with x=median latency (ms, log scale), y=$ / 1k tokens. color by primary use-case and add a dotted 'SLA sweet spot' box. include a small waterfall inset showing batching + cache deltas.

tom: throwing a layout CSV for design to use (layout-only numbers):
```
model,median_ms,cost_per_1k,use_case
redwood-8k,52,0.056,chat
redwood-13b,118,0.073,search
open-13b-q4,87,0.049,rerank
gptx-lite,230,0.129,batch
```

sophie: headline A/B test options: A) "Predictable unit economics for shipped features" B) "Keep UX fast as you scale". we'll A/B on the hero and email subject.

miguel: webinar plan: 20m hands-on demo (cache + batching knobs), 20m customer case study, 15m live tuning Q&A. CTA: download the benchmark kit + start a Dedicated trial. routing: >30 seats -> AE queue; else nurture.

hana: design asks: hero PNG 1200x628, three microcards (chat/search/rerank) 600x400 each, one 8s GIF showing p95 fall after prefix-caching. need a short methodology blurb: median & p95 over steady-state runs; cost model includes batching + cache effects; anonymized customer examples optional.

tom: supporting stats to cite on page: prefix cache ~= 24% token reduction on search slice; batching @150 qps ~= 17% cost reduction. i'll validate and upload final CSV by EOD.

ops-bot: bench-run-5932 completed. artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-bench/5932/ (preview + data) :white_check_mark:

sophie: perfect. action list: tom -> final CSV (EOD), hana -> hero + microcards comps (tomorrow AM), miguel -> routing rules + tracking (today), design -> GIF + social assets. i'll draft the landing copy and a short tweet once the hero mock lands. ping here for any blockers. :rocket:
